scope: Adopt the desktop-foundation v0.9.0 command grammar (status, commands, tui, doctor, control, approvals, permissions) with the shared envelope; person-gated decide verbs; owner.stop without signals; retire the removed menu bar login item through the foundation retire module; remove the orphaned menubar snapshot.
reviewer: Independent AI reviewer: two separate read-only Claude Code (Opus) processes, not the drafting session
method: Read-only review of the branch against origin/main, then a verification pass over the fixes for the first pass's blocking findings; no edits or tests by the reviewer.
result: First pass: two blocking findings (a build test still read doctor --json at the top level; permissions set reported a turn-on as applied while its job was still running) and eight non-blocking. Fixed: the build test reads the envelope; permissions set waits on the job and reports pending; control stop only reports not-running for a missing or refused socket; a lost answer after approvals decide allow-once is indeterminate and never invites a retry. The verification pass confirmed all fixes with no new double-send path, gate bypass or weakened test. Decide verbs are gated before any control request; the one-time code is read only from the controlling terminal. After merging main (#263, public spelling TextButler), only product-name strings and their snapshots changed; the digests above are for the merged bytes.
remainingLimit: Older product verbs that change the same state (daemon install, contacts enable, replies send, resume) stay decide-legacy and still run for agents until they migrate. doctor --json exits 1 with an ok envelope when setup is not ready, matching the previous doctor exit code. The local-custody socket client reports every socket error with one message, so control stop cannot tell a permission error from a refused connection. The gate's terminal challenge was not exercised with a live person in this review.
